notify.fan_error_body: Could not set the fan mode/speed. Check the Noctalia service log for the driver error.
notify.power_profile_error_body: Could not change the power profile. Check that power-profiles-daemon is running.

panel.title: Fan control
panel.unavailable: No supported fan control found (thinkpad_acpi or a known hwmon chip). See the plugin README.

auto_color.description: Color while in Auto mode (color_trigger = Mode). Empty uses the theme's neutral color.
auto_color.label: Auto color

bar_display.description: What to show next to the icon in the bar
bar_display.label: Bar display

bar_icon.description: Symbol shown by the bar widget
bar_icon.label: Bar icon

bar_show_units.description: Show "RPM"/"°C" next to the number in the bar
bar_show_units.label: Show units in bar

colorize_icon.description: Tint the bar icon according to "Color by" below
colorize_icon.label: Colorize icon

colorize_text.description: Tint the bar text according to "Color by" below
colorize_text.label: Colorize text

alt_mode.description: For firmware or power-profile-controlled hosts where PWM writes have no effect. Keeps RPM/temperature reporting and controls power-profiles-daemon instead of direct PWM writes.
alt_mode.label: Alternate mode (power-profile controlled)

full_color.description: Color while at Full blast. Empty uses the theme's error color.
full_color.label: Full-blast color

load_high_color.description: Color for each load-average value above the CPU count. Empty uses the theme's error color.
load_high_color.label: High load color

hwmon_name.description: Extra hwmon chip name to also treat as a controllable fan (matches /sys/class/hwmon/hwmon*/name), on top of the built-in dell_smm and gpdfan. Leave empty unless auto-detection misses your hardware.
hwmon_name.label: Extra hwmon chip name

manual_color.description: Color while at a manual speed (color_trigger = Mode). Empty uses the theme's accent color.
manual_color.label: Manual color

percent_step.description: Granularity of manual speed changes: the slider's step size, and how much the increase/decrease actions change it by
percent_step.label: Speed step (%)

rpm_high_color.description: Color at or above the high fan-speed threshold (color_trigger = Fan speed). Empty uses the theme's error/warning color.
rpm_high_color.label: High-speed color

rpm_low_color.description: Color below the low fan-speed threshold (color_trigger = Fan speed). Empty uses the theme's neutral color.
rpm_low_color.label: Low-speed color

rpm_mid_color.description: Color between the two fan-speed thresholds (color_trigger = Fan speed). Empty uses the theme's accent color.
rpm_mid_color.label: Mid-speed color

rpm_threshold_high.description: Fan speed (RPM) at or above which the high-speed color applies
rpm_threshold_high.label: High fan-speed threshold (RPM)

rpm_threshold_low.description: Fan speed (RPM) below which the low-speed color applies
rpm_threshold_low.label: Low fan-speed threshold (RPM)

temp_high_color.description: Color at or above the high temperature threshold (color_trigger = Temperature). Empty uses the theme's error/warning color.
temp_high_color.label: High-temperature color

temp_low_color.description: Color below the low temperature threshold (color_trigger = Temperature). Empty uses the theme's neutral color.
temp_low_color.label: Low-temperature color

temp_mid_color.description: Color between the two temperature thresholds (color_trigger = Temperature). Empty uses the theme's accent color.
temp_mid_color.label: Mid-temperature color

temp_threshold_high.description: Temperature (°C) at or above which the high-temperature color applies
temp_threshold_high.label: High temperature threshold (°C)

temp_threshold_low.description: Temperature (°C) below which the low-temperature color applies
temp_threshold_low.label: Low temperature threshold (°C)

thermal_zone.description: sysfs thermal zone used for the temperature, e.g. thermal_zone0
thermal_zone.label: Thermal zone
